inspected_source_facts: return column resolves to return_5d for the frozen five-session horizon
daily_top5 converts return_5d to numeric, fills missing values with zero, groups only by event_date, and marks the five highest observation rows positive

ranking lanes train deterministic weighted logistic models on daily_top5 labels; full and recent-half differ only by training window
top5 model uses the same daily_top5 transformation through the specialized logistic recipe
tail-aware weights are 4 for big_gain, 3 for big_loss, and 1 otherwise; evaluation group economics are unweighted
predict_proba returns sigmoid of the fitted positive-class logit; higher scores support descending selection
